Use original recordings or synthesis; do not sample reference games, copy recognizable character voices, or imitate a named performer. Export WAV, signed PCM 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, peak no higher than -1 dBFS. Judge short sounds by peak and perceived loudness; do not force an integrated LUFS target.
